subject: Physics
source_note: TIE (2023), Physics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Apply knowledge of Physics in various contexts

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts, theories and principles of Physics
competences: (a) Describe the concept and principles of light (sources of light, propagation and transmission, image formation, colours, optical instruments)
(b) Describe the concept and principles of magnetism (magnetization and demagnetization, magnetic fields)
(c) Explain the concept and principles of static electricity (detection of static charges, types of materials, capacitors, charge distributions and lightning conductor)
(d) Describe the concept and laws of current electricity (electromotive force, potential difference, resistance, effect of electric current, domestic electrical installation)

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concept and principles of light (sources of light, propagation and transmission, image formation, colours, optical instruments)
objectives.resources: Torch, candle, cardboard with slit, light emitting diodes and fluorescent tube
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts and principles of light are described correctly

objectives.text: (b) Describe the concept and principles of magnetism (magnetization and demagnetization, magnetic fields)
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, ICT based learning, Project work
objectives.resources: Different types of magnets, iron fillings, card board, connecting wires and batteries
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts and principles of magnetism are described correctly

objectives.text: (c) Explain the concept and principles of static electricity (detection of static charges, types of materials, capacitors, charge distributions and lightning conductor)
objectives.resources: Small pieces of paper, plastic comb, polythene rod, capacitor and lighting conductor, rod and wires
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts and principles of static electricity are clearly explained

objectives.text: (d) Describe the concept and laws of current electricity (electromotive force, potential difference, resistance, effect of electric current, domestic electrical installation)
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, Hands-on activity, Interactive simulations
objectives.resources: Ammeter, Voltmeter, switch. Meter bridge, resistors, connecting wire and batteries
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept and laws of current electricity are described correctly

sub_topics.title: Use mathematics to explain physical principles and phenomena
competences: (a) Apply mathematical knowledge to describe various relations related to light and current electricity

objectives.text: (a) Apply mathematical knowledge to describe various relations related to light and current electricity
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, Think ink pair share, Problem based learning
objectives.assessment_criteria: Mathematical knowledge is applied correctly to describe various relations related to light and current electricity

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic experimental skills in Physics
competences: (a) Carry out experiments related to light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity

objectives.text: (a) Carry out experiments related to light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity
objectives.resources: Ammeter, Voltmeter, switch. Meter bridge, resistor, connecting wire, Torch, card board with slits, triangular prism, plane mirrors and curved mirrors
objectives.assessment_criteria: Experiments related to light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity are carried out correctly

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of data analysis, presentation and report writing in Physics
competences: (a) Use spreadsheet to process experimental data in physics
(b) Use graphs to analyse and determine mathematical relationships between various variables in Physics

objectives.text: (a) Use spreadsheet to process experimental data in physics
objectives.assessment_criteria: Experimental data are correctily processed using various spread sheet programs

objectives.text: (b) Use graphs to analyse and determine mathematical relationships between various variables in Physics
objectives.resources: Online resources, graph paper, protractor, ruler, manila, chart other resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The graphs are used appropriately to analyse and determine mathematical relationships between various variables in Physics

objectives.teaching_methods: Cooperative learning, Problem-based learning, Guided practice approach
objectives.resources: Variuos graphs based on experimental data and Online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The experimental results are communicate orally correctly

topics.title: Evaluate and use information in Physics

sub_topics.title: Collect, describe and relate physical data
competences: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical quantities (light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity)
(b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity

objectives.text: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical quantities (light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity)
objectives.teaching_methods: Problem-solving approach, Collaborative learning, ICT-based approach
objectives.assessment_criteria: Collected physics data are correctly analysed to explain various physical quantities

objectives.text: (b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity
objectives.resources: Online resources, watch, trolley and model
objectives.assessment_criteria: Collected physics data are correctly analysed to explain experimental observations related to light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity

sub_topics.title: Carry out a project in Physics
competences: (a) Develop prototype devices based on the concepts, theories, principles, and laws gained from the field of light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity

objectives.text: (a) Develop prototype devices based on the concepts, theories, principles, and laws gained from the field of light, magnetism, static electricity and current electricity
objectives.assessment_criteria: Appropriate prototype devices are developed based on the concepts, theories, principles, and laws gained from given Physics concepts
